persona: Casual local AI research and ordinary work

B01.reason: Remove repetition while retaining one useful hint and truthful configuration state.

B02.reason: Document context is the ordinary decision; labelled custom batch and Adjust preserve discovery.

B03.reason: Compact qualified reading and answer ranges provide immediate tuning feedback without the repeated timing story.

B04.reason: Save and available Apply remain clear; less frequent actions can use a labelled menu with validation preserved.

B05.reason: Show descriptions avoids repeated row disclosures for readers who need explanations while preserving Expert scope.

B06.reason: One exact winner with profile chips prevents duplicate actions and keeps other winners and no-fit visible without selector exploration.

B07.reason: Exact variant identity supports choosing and reproducing a setup; wrapping is preferable to opaque aliases.

B08.reason: Fit, working memory and download govern commitment; speed details and comparison remain available without suggesting suitability.

B09.reason: Compact no-fit recovery and an explicit shared winner reduce redundant card height and download confusion.

B10.reason: Installed-first daily access and remembered choice reduce repeated browsing while retaining Discover and exact variants.

B11.reason: Aligned rows expose differences and per-variant evidence with much less repetition than three nested panels.

B12.reason: A preserved download/configuration review can contain optional tuning without another compulsory setup stop.

B13.reason: Plain purposes make the three priorities easier to choose; canonical names remain accessible in Details.

B14.reason: Compact detected facts, exact choice, fit and actual download amount retain the information needed before commitment.

B15.reason: Stage-local recovery and visible cancellation consequences matter more than duplicated progress narration.

B16.reason: Ready should confirm actual loaded or Demo state and lead directly to Chat with optional technical depth.

B17.reason: Known shared-engine scope and consistent lifecycle blockers prevent disruption of ordinary ongoing work.

B18.reason: A correctly scoped source badge removes repetition while local mixed, estimated and unknown states preserve meaning.

B19.reason: One actual review-status line prevents a qualified starting recommendation from appearing to establish research suitability.

B20.reason: Text sample labels retain exact token assumptions without implying document-format or research-task capability.

amendments: B13: Explain long prompts in Tools and agents help; Faster answers names a priority, not a measured guarantee for this setup.
B19: Use existing capability-review metadata only; do not expand a general review into a verified research, accuracy or task-specific claim.
B03: Keep memory and fit visually prior to the compact rates; do not promote demo ranges into a hardware prediction.
B12: Auto-open optional tuning when retained values are invalid, showing their exact values and an explicit recovery action.
B06: Merge only the same exact variant and compatible displayed configuration; preserve separate priority rationales when winners coincide.
